title: Ammonia synthesis membrane reactor: 2D axisymmetric model and paper pipeline
description:
A two-dimensional axisymmetric, non-isothermal model of a packed bed membrane reactor for ammonia synthesis over a Ru/C catalyst, together with the one-dimensional models it is compared against and the cached pipeline that regenerates every figure and the archived dataset of the accompanying paper.

The package includes a fitted, Reynolds-independent Sherwood correction for the concentration polarization at the membrane wall, and a mechanistic reaction-screened closure that reproduces it from the local kinetics with a single order-one constant and no geometry fit. Notebooks re-render every figure from the archived dataset and run on Google Colab.
